 News 
 Benidorm Fest 
 Benidorm Fest 2027 tickets: on sale from 24 to 26 November, €40 for the semi-finals and €75 for the final
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Lucas Moreno 
 19 Nov 2026, 09:00 
 A 3-minute read 
 RTVE 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Each Benidorm Fest 2027 show has its own sale day : tickets for the first semi-final go on sale on Tuesday 24 November, the second on Wednesday 25 and the final on Thursday 26, always at 12:00 on Vivaticket. 
 The semi-finals cost €40 and the final €75 , plus booking fees, and every ticket includes a CD with the songs of the 18 entries. 
 The shows will take place on 26, 28 and 30 January at the Palau d'Esports l'Illa , and the songs will not be revealed until 17 December: you buy without having heard them. 
 You need to be ready before 12:00 : in the 2025 edition, the 1,000 tickets for the final sold out in about 20 seconds. 
 There is now a date for securing a place at Benidorm Fest 2027 . RTVE will sell tickets for its three shows on three consecutive days, from Tuesday 24 to Thursday 26 November , from 12:00 on Vivaticket: €40 per semi-final and €75 for the final, plus booking fees.
 Festival guide 
 Benidorm Fest 2027 
 26–30 Jan 2027 · Benidorm 
 See festival guide 
 One sale day for each show
 Tickets are sold by show, not as passes. Each day, tickets for just one night go on sale:
 Tuesday 24 November, at 12:00: first semi-final, held on Tuesday 26 January.
 Wednesday 25 November, at 12:00: second semi-final, on Thursday 28 January.
 Thursday 26 November, at 12:00: final, on Saturday 30 January.
 Tickets are bought online, at vivaticket.es. RTVE has not said how many seats are available for each show or whether there will be a ticket limit per buyer. The calendar does change, though: the sale has been brought forward by a month compared with the previous edition, when tickets for the semi-finals went on sale at the end of December .
 €40 for the semi-finals, €75 for the final and a free CD
 The semi-finals cost €40 and the final €75 . Booking fees, which RTVE has not specified, are added to these amounts. Every ticket includes a compilation CD with the songs of the 18 entries, a disc which, according to ESCplus, will not be sold.
 What there will not be this year is a pass for the dress rehearsal of the final : according to ESCplus, RTVE will not open it to the public; in 2026 that pass was cancelled for technical and organisational reasons and the money was refunded.
 Three shows at the Palau d'Esports l'Illa, from 26 to 30 January
 All three shows take place at the Palau d'Esports l'Illa in Benidorm , the same venue that hosted the 2026 final, as part of a festival week in the city that RTVE places from 23 to 30 January . Competing are the 18 artists unveiled in October , from Merche and Isabel Aaiún to Ladilla Rusa, Bombai and Vicco, who returns after taking part in the 2024 edition.
 The songs will be presented on 17 December , three weeks after the sale ends. Anyone buying in November chooses a show based on the names and the format: the semi-finals decide who goes through and only the final crowns the winner. Nor is it settled whether that win will earn a place at Eurovision: in September the president of RTVE proposed keeping Spain out of the contest and the decision remains in the hands of the Board of Directors.
 Presentation of the 18 Benidorm Fest 2027 artists. Image: RTVE How to be in time for the sale
 Experience from previous years suggests not taking anything for granted. In December 2024, the 1,000 tickets for the final of Benidorm Fest 2025 sold out in about 20 seconds , with 105,000 people connected at the same time, according to Vivaticket figures reported by Esdiario. It is a good idea to go to the website a few minutes before 12:00, with your show chosen and your payment details to hand, and to bear in mind that each night is sold on a different day: anyone wanting to attend more than one show will have to buy again on the relevant day.
 News about the contest, from the presentation of the songs to the running order, will be added to the Benidorm Fest page . For the rest of the winter, there is the festival calendar and the calendar of festivals in the Valencian Community .
 Sources: RTVE.es (sale announcement, 18 November 2026); ESCplus (18 November 2026); Esdiario (13 December 2024); our coverage of the Benidorm Fest 2027 artists and the 2026 sale.
